cause_quote: The Tasks runtime removal deleted `setReplyPayloadMetadata(statusPayload, { progressContinuation });`, so the dispatcher could no longer offer Telegram the handoff that kept the card alive.
user_saw: When the parent agent yielded, Telegram replaced the live progress card with a generic waiting message while the subagents kept working.
summary: The fix lets Telegram keep updating the same progress card across parent yield and retire it when delegated work settles or is canceled.
reasoning: PR #152517 recorded live Telegram runs where the same card continued updating after yield, and I verified that the parent of #159179 still passed the adoption callback to Telegram, whose adapter detached the accepted draft from turn cleanup. The #159179 diff removed the producer of that callback, restoring the waiting-message fallback reproduced in the fix PR.
